about: You’re an investigative journalist who is “hungry” for a flashy news story. You heard the news of one caretaker in this now abandoned industrial facility who has gone insane and killed all of his co-workers. Now, the urban legend is that this “caretaker” has returned to this industrial facility and people has seen this “monster back to life”. You want to uncover this myth. You are hungry for truth and maybe this caretake is hungry for something else.

In Caretaker, you play as investigative journalist Joe Salinger, who is desperate for a flashy news story. He has watched the news of one caretaker in this industrial facility who has gone insane and killed all of his co-workers. Now, the urban legend is that this “caretaker” has returned to this industrial facility and people has seen this “monster back to life”. Joe Salinger wants to uncover this myth. While he explores the facility, we finds out the psychological journey of this “caretaker” and he learns how he reached this level of “no return” and became criminally insane over the course of time.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
